reviewPolicy: 30-day monetary review window; expired or unreviewed records suppress estimates. A review date is not an enactment or effective date.
scope: Speeding only; program-specific rules. Not a complete statement of current traffic law.

sources.title: New York Senate · VTL §1180
sources.reviewNote: §1180(h)(1), (3), (5): ordinary/work-zone ranges and repeat-offense maximum increases. School-zone paragraph (4) is not modeled.

sources.title: New York State · Automated Work Zone Speed Enforcement
sources.reviewNote: First violation $50; second within 18 months $75; third and subsequent within 18 months $100. No license points; late fees can apply.

sources.title: New York Senate · VTL §1180-b
sources.reviewNote: Monetary liability shall not exceed fifty dollars for each violation; additional late penalty may apply. NYC program only. Source includes provisions taking effect in 2027; no future procedural provision is applied.

sources.title: Pennsylvania General Assembly · 75 Pa.C.S. §3362
sources.reviewNote: Base $42.50 when the maximum speed limit is 65 mph or higher; otherwise $35. Add $2 per mph exceeding five mph over the maximum.

sources.title: Pennsylvania General Assembly · 75 Pa.C.S. §3369
sources.reviewNote: First offense written warning; second $75; third and subsequent $150. A second or subsequent offense must occur at least 15 days after mailing of the warning. Active and in-use system required.

sources.title: Pennsylvania General Assembly · 75 Pa.C.S. §3326
sources.reviewNote: §3362 fines double in qualifying active work zones manned by workers, with required official signs. Other injury and license consequences are separate.

sources.title: Maryland General Assembly · Transportation §21-810
sources.reviewNote: 12–15 mph over $60; 16–19 $80; 20–29 $140; 30–39 $270; 40+ $500. Double these amounts when workers are present. This is not the schedule for other Maryland camera programs.

sources.title: Virginia Legislative Information System · §46.2-882.1
sources.reviewNote: At least 10 mph over; civil penalty shall not exceed $100. Work-zone liability requires workers present. A personally issued summons can carry different record consequences from a mailed notice. Page includes future 2027 provisions; those are not applied.

sources.title: Virginia Legislative Information System · §46.2-878.3
sources.reviewNote: Where prepayment is permitted: $6 per mph ordinary, $7 for specified school/work-zone offenses. Extra $100 for over 80 but below 86 on a 65 mph road. Other specified residential rules not modeled.

sources.title: Virginia Legislative Information System · §46.2-862
sources.reviewNote: Reckless-driving speed threshold: 20 mph or more above the limit, or over 85 mph regardless of limit.

sources.title: California Legislature · Vehicle Code §22426
sources.reviewNote: AB 645 pilot: 11–15 mph over $50; 16–25 $100; 26+ $200 unless actual speed is at least 100 mph, then $500. Civil penalty, no violation point.

sources.title: California Legislature · Vehicle Code §22425
sources.reviewNote: Six designated local jurisdictions only. Excludes interstates, state routes and other specified roads. Initial 60-day warning periods; vehicle’s first 11–15 mph violation in a jurisdiction is a warning. Income-based reductions available.

sources.title: New Jersey Courts · Published Statewide Violations Bureau Schedule
sources.reviewNote: Document is dated July 29, 2021. Retained as a dated source; not enabled for a current monetary calculation until superseding schedules and applicability are checked.

sources.title: New Jersey DOT · Red Light Running Pilot
sources.reviewNote: Agency reports that the former red-light pilot ended December 16, 2014. Historical camera lists do not establish present enforcement authority.

sources.title: DC Office of Documents · 18 DCMR §2600
sources.reviewNote: Current index lists an August 7, 2026 amendment. Monetary calculation held for review of the adopted text rather than using an older indexed schedule.

rules.title: Work-zone camera
rules.scope: Eligible operational NY work-zone program; not every construction project.
rules.notes: Prior offenses are counted within the applicable 18-month period. Workers, signs, program operation and the recorded violation must satisfy program requirements.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: NYC school-zone camera
rules.scope: New York City only; not a statewide school-camera rate.
rules.notes: This is a statutory cap, not a payable-total prediction. Camera program conditions are separate from officer-issued school-zone citations.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: Officer-issued speeding citation
rules.notes: Correct charging subsection matters. School-zone, hazardous-material and defective commercial-vehicle cases are excluded. Possible imprisonment and license consequences are not priced.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: Work-zone camera
rules.program: PA active work-zone speed safety cameras
rules.notes: First warning and the subsequent 15-day condition matter. No operating-record points under this civil program.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: Officer-issued speeding citation
rules.scope: Ordinary speeding; conditional doubling in staffed, officially signed active work zones.
rules.notes: The fine is only one portion of a payable ticket. License suspension, points, safe-speed, reckless and injury charges require separate assessment.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: Work-zone camera
rules.scope: Transportation §21-810 only; not local school/residential/I-83 camera programs.
rules.notes: Worker presence doubles the applicable tier. A police citation for the same violation changes camera liability. No license points under this civil provision.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: Mailed speed-camera notice
rules.scope: This calculator models eligible work and school zones only, not every category authorized by the statute.
rules.notes: Shows the statutory cap; the actual local rate may be lower. Work-zone camera liability requires workers present. No driving-record conviction for a qualifying mailed notice.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: Officer-issued speeding citation
rules.scope: Prepayable ordinary and specified school/work-zone offenses.
rules.notes: Reckless-driving thresholds stop the routine estimate. Prepayment availability, charging section, court costs and special residential-zone rules need separate checking.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

rules.title: Local pilot speed camera
rules.scope: Designated pilot jurisdictions: Los Angeles, San Jose, Oakland, Glendale, Long Beach, and the City and County of San Francisco. Eligible local streets only.
rules.notes: Not a nationwide or statewide highway program. No assumption that a jurisdiction has activated cameras. First 60 days at a new location require warnings; first vehicle violation at 11–15 mph over is also a warning. Income-based reductions are not calculated.
rules.excludes: Late/default fees, court costs, surcharges, other charges, insurance changes and nonmonetary consequences are not totaled. Local reductions or payment alternatives may apply.

holds.reason: Current monetary schedule and present camera authority require review; dated 2021 schedule and expired pilot are not treated as current penalties.
2026 amendment requires adopted-text review before monetary estimates are enabled.
